Run once to measure the noise floor. 2,164 dockets, dominated by District of Massachusetts, Southern District of Florida and Western District of Pennsylvania filings referring to those districts' own local rules numbered 16.1. Recorded for two reasons: it shows why the sweep uses full naming forms rather than the bare rule number, and it is the control that the earlier local-rule collision test got wrong.
